STATUS: ANSWER
Two GPU-accelerated germline callers from NVIDIA Parabricks are supported: Parabricks DeepVariant and Parabricks HaplotypeCaller [sarek_output#h034][sarek_output#h035]. Both are experimental additions to the pipeline [sarek_usage#h010].
The support table lists these callers against several input types, but its column headers are not included in the provided sources, so I cannot state for which input types each caller is supported [sarek_usage#h037].
